lead_independence.headline: Fort Pierce Trial: Mimms' Niece Testifies on Lincoln Park Nonprofit Lease
lead_independence.lead: The corruption trial of former Fort Pierce City Manager Nicholas Mimms, underway at the St. Lucie County Courthouse over a bid process involving two vacant city-owned lots in the Lincoln Park area, moved forward Thursday with testimony from Mimms' niece and a lead FDLE investigator. Earlier proceedings had focused on a parking provision
